description: Centrifuge Modeling of Buried Water Reservoirs is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Katerina Ziotopoulou, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). Buried water reservoirs have become a competitive option for water storage and conveyance in U.S. cities along the Pacific coast. Local municipalities rely on buried water reservoirs to deliver water int eh event of an emergency (e.g. fire fighting and continuous supply when other infrastructure systems fail). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Centrifuge, CGM, Buried Reservoir, Center for Geotechnical Modeling. Published 2024-05-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
